core_obligations: Produce the dense affine trivializing open and its Cartier complement

proof_roadmap.step: Choose U, the trivialization, and the divisor D

Reduce the claim to the affine scheme case

difficulty_reason: The retained proof: take a dense affine open U trivializing L (dense schematic open exists for separated spaces); the complement is an effective Cartier divisor D; the claim is that for some n > 0 the trivialization s of L over U extends uniquely to O_X(-nD) -> L. The claim gives the result because then L(nD) has a regular global section and the O(D)-characterization lemma identifies it with O(D'). The claim is etale-local, so affinoize to a Noetherian scheme where O(-nD) = I^n and the extension is the scheme-level Hom-over-open lemma. Retained author proof at lines 1854-1877.

compared.note: The scheme-level statement sits in the Divisors chapter and is only an input here; the spaces formulation (dense open, étale localization of the claim) is this card's content.
